description: Address code review findings: move inline <style> from Testimonials.tsx into tailwind.config.js keyframes/animation, and fix social links using buttons to avoid scroll-to-top behavior.
steps: Move @keyframes scroll and animate-scroll class from inline <style> in Testimonials.tsx to tailwind.config.js under theme.extend.keyframes and theme.extend.animation
Update Testimonials.tsx to use Tailwind animate-scroll utility class and group-hover:[animation-play-state:paused] arbitrary value instead of inline CSS
Fix social links in Contact.tsx to use button elements instead of <a href='#'> to avoid scroll-to-top
Fix social links in Footer.tsx to use button elements instead of <a href='#'> to avoid scroll-to-top
Run npm run build to verify changes compile cleanly
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind config defines scroll keyframes and animate-scroll animation
Testimonials carousel still scrolls infinitely and pauses on hover
Social links do not navigate or scroll to top when clicked
